translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata inputMod)
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize progressions.module
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions preparedBindings.functions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups =
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }

src/Gopurs/CountedFunctionSums.purs.text:
module Gopurs.CountedFunctionSums (optimize) where

import Prelude hiding (add, apply, compare)

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Control.Monad.State (State, StateT, evalState, get, put, runStateT)
import Control.Monad.Trans.Class (lift)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Set (Set)
import Data.Set as Set
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (maximumLevel)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Convert (BackendModule)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), Literal(..), ModuleName, Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(..), Level(..), Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

type Ref = Tuple (Maybe Ident) Level
type Env = Map.Map Ref Value
type Context =
  { owner :: ModuleName
  , globals :: Map.Map Ident NeutralExpr
  , producers :: Set Ident
  , active :: Set Ident
  , outer :: Boolean
  , depth :: Int
  }

data Scalar
  = Constant Int
  | Input Ref
  | Parameter Int
  | Sum Scalar Scalar
  | Product Scalar Scalar

data Value
  = Integer Scalar
  | Closure (Array Ref) NeutralExpr Env (Set Ident) Boolean
  | Producer
  | Iterator Scalar
  | Repeated Scalar Value

type Proof =
  { fuel :: Int
  , next :: Int
  , inputs :: Set Ref
  , counts :: Array Scalar
  , used :: Boolean
  }
type Eval = StateT Proof Maybe

-- Only fully consumed, structurally known function iterators are reduced.
-- Their arbitrary pure wrappers are interpreted with bounded fuel; foreign
-- calls, effects, opaque callbacks and recursive initialization are rejected.
-- A runtime guard retains the original expression for negative counts and
-- values outside signed Int32. No benchmark names or chosen inputs enter here.
optimize :: Set Ident -> BackendModule -> BackendModule
optimize producers mod
  | Set.isEmpty producers = mod
  | otherwise =
      let
        globals = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.filter (\(Tuple name _) -> not (Map.member name mod.foreign))
          (Array.concatMap _.bindings (Array.filter (not <<< _.recursive) mod.bindings))
        context = { owner: mod.name, globals, producers, active: Set.empty, outer: true, depth: 0 }
      in mod { bindings = map (\group -> group { bindings = map (\(Tuple name body) ->
        Tuple name (rewrite context body)) group.bindings }) mod.bindings }

rewrite :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
rewrite context original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = case candidate context original of
  Just rewritten -> rewritten
  Nothing -> NeutralExpr (map (rewrite context) syntax)

candidate :: Context -> NeutralExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
candidate context original@(NeutralExpr syntax) = do
  case syntax of
    Typed Int _ -> pure unit
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple result proof <- runStateT (evaluate context Map.empty original)
    { fuel: 768, next: 0, inputs: Set.empty, counts: [], used: false }
  scalar <- case result of
    Integer value | proof.used && closed value -> Just value
    _ -> Nothing
  let
    inputGuards = Array.concatMap (\ref ->
      [ compare Syn.OpGte (reference ref) (integer (-2147483647 - 1))
      , compare Syn.OpLte (reference ref) (integer 2147483647)
      ]) (Set.toUnfoldable proof.inputs :: Array Ref)
    emit = do
      countGuards <- traverse (\count -> do
        value <- emitScalar count
        pure (compare Syn.OpGte value (integer 0))) proof.counts
      resultExpr <- emitScalar scalar
      let conditions = inputGuards <> countGuards
      pure case NEA.fromArray conditions of
        Nothing -> resultExpr
        Just nonempty -> typed Int (NeutralExpr (Branch
          (NEA.singleton (Pair (foldl (binary Boolean Syn.OpBooleanAnd) (NEA.head nonempty) (NEA.tail nonempty)) resultExpr)) original))
  pure (evalState emit (maximumLevel original + 1))

evaluate :: Context -> Env -> NeutralExpr -> Eval Value
evaluate context env (NeutralExpr syntax) = do
  proof <- get
  lift $ guard (proof.fuel > 0 && context.depth < 64)
  put (proof { fuel = proof.fuel - 1 })
  let child = context { depth = context.depth + 1 }
      go = evaluate child env
  case syntax of
    Typed Int inner -> case inner of
      NeutralExpr (Local ident level) -> case Map.lookup (Tuple ident level) env of
        Just value -> pure value
        Nothing -> do
          lift $ guard context.outer
          state <- get
          let ref = Tuple ident level
          put (state { inputs = Set.insert ref state.inputs })
          pure (Integer (Input ref))
      _ -> go inner
    Typed ty inner -> do
      lift $ guard (functionAnnotation ty)
      go inner
    Syn.TypeApp inner _ -> go inner
    Lit (LitInt value) -> pure (Integer (Constant value))
    Local ident level -> lift (Map.lookup (Tuple ident level) env)
    Var (Qualified owner name) -> do
      lift $ guard (owner == Nothing || owner == Just context.owner)
      if Set.member name context.producers then pure Producer
      else do
        lift $ guard (not (Set.member name context.active))
        body <- lift (Map.lookup name context.globals)
        evaluate (child { active = Set.insert name context.active, outer = false }) Map.empty body
    Abs refs body -> pure (Closure (NEA.toArray refs) body env context.active context.outer)
    Let ident level value body -> do
      evaluated <- go value
      evaluate child (Map.insert (Tuple ident level) evaluated env) body
    App fn args -> do
      callable <- go fn
      arguments <- traverse go (NEA.toArray args)
      apply child callable arguments
    PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) left right) -> do
      a <- go left >>= scalarValue
      b <- go right >>= scalarValue
      pure (Integer (add a b))
    PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpSubtract) left right) -> do
      a <- go left >>= scalarValue
      b <- go right >>= scalarValue
      case b of
        Constant value -> pure (Integer (add a (Constant (negate value))))
        _ -> lift Nothing
    _ -> lift Nothing

apply :: Context -> Value -> Array Value -> Eval Value
apply context value arguments = do
  lift $ guard (context.depth < 64)
  case value of
    Closure parameters body captured active outer -> do
      let count = min (Array.length parameters) (Array.length arguments)
          env = Map.union (Map.fromFoldable (Array.zip (Array.take count parameters) (Array.take count arguments))) captured
          pending = Array.drop count parameters
          supplied = Array.drop count arguments
      if not (Array.null pending) then pure (Closure pending body env active outer)
      else do
        result <- evaluate (context { active = active, outer = outer }) env body
        if Array.null supplied then pure result
        else apply (context { depth = context.depth + 1 }) result supplied
    _ -> case Array.uncons arguments of
      Nothing -> pure value
      Just { head, tail } -> do
        result <- applyOne context value head
        if Array.null tail then pure result
        else apply (context { depth = context.depth + 1 }) result tail

applyOne :: Context -> Value -> Value -> Eval Value
applyOne context value argument = case value of
  Producer -> do
    count <- scalarValue argument
    lift $ guard (closed count)
    proof <- get
    put (proof { counts = Array.snoc proof.counts count })
    pure (Iterator count)
  Iterator count -> pure (Repeated count argument)
  Repeated count callback -> do
    seed <- scalarValue argument
    proof <- get
    let parameter = proof.next
    put (proof { next = parameter + 1 })
    result <- apply (context { depth = context.depth + 1 }) callback [ Integer (Parameter parameter) ] >>= scalarValue
    offset <- lift (translation parameter result)
    current <- get
    put (current { used = true })
    pure (Integer (add seed (multiply count offset)))
  _ -> lift Nothing

scalarValue :: Value -> Eval Scalar
scalarValue (Integer scalar) = pure scalar
scalarValue _ = lift Nothing

-- A callback must be precisely a translation of its one argument. This rejects
-- multiplication, duplicated arguments, discarded arguments and opaque calls.
translation :: Int -> Scalar -> Maybe Scalar
translation parameter = case _ of
  Parameter found | found == parameter -> Just (Constant 0)
  Sum left right | closed right -> (\offset -> add offset right) <$> translation parameter left
  Sum left right | closed left -> (add left) <$> translation parameter right
  _ -> Nothing

closed :: Scalar -> Boolean
closed = case _ of
  Parameter _ -> false
  Sum a b -> closed a && closed b
  Product a b -> closed a && closed b
  _ -> true

add :: Scalar -> Scalar -> Scalar
add (Constant 0) right = right
add left (Constant 0) = left
add (Constant left) (Constant right) = Constant (left + right)
add left right = Sum left right

multiply :: Scalar -> Scalar -> Scalar
multiply (Constant 0) _ = Constant 0
multiply _ (Constant 0) = Constant 0
multiply (Constant 1) right = right
multiply left (Constant 1) = left
multiply left right = Product left right

-- Repeated IntAdd is exact modulo 2^32. Prelude IntMul instead rounds a JS
-- Number product before narrowing, so it is not a valid replacement at large
-- inputs. Splitting one signed operand into 16-bit pieces keeps both products
-- exact in Number arithmetic, including overflow and negative increments.
emitScalar :: Scalar -> State Int NeutralExpr
emitScalar = case _ of
  Constant value -> pure (integer value)
  Input ref -> pure (reference ref)
  Parameter _ -> pure (NeutralExpr (Fail "unbound counted-function parameter"))
  Sum left right -> binary Int (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) <$> emitScalar left <*> emitScalar right
  Product left right -> do
    a <- emitScalar left
    b <- emitScalar right
    next <- get
    put (next + 2)
    let
      first = Tuple (Just (Ident "countedFactor")) (Level next)
      second = Tuple (Just (Ident "countedIncrement")) (Level (next + 1))
      x = reference first
      y = reference second
      low = binary Int (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpMultiply) (binary Int Syn.OpIntBitAnd x (integer 65535)) y
      high = binary Int Syn.OpIntBitShiftLeft
        (binary Int (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpMultiply) (binary Int Syn.OpIntBitShiftRight x (integer 16)) y) (integer 16)
      result = binary Int (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) low high
    pure (typed Int (NeutralExpr (Let (Just (Ident "countedFactor")) (Level next) a
      (typed Int (NeutralExpr (Let (Just (Ident "countedIncrement")) (Level (next + 1)) b result))))))

-- Representation annotations must not turn a Number or another primitive
-- into a proof about Int32 arithmetic. Function/newtype-polymorphic wrappers
-- remain admissible; their bodies must still use the supported integer syntax.
functionAnnotation :: ExprType -> Boolean
functionAnnotation = case _ of
  Func _ _ -> true
  ForAll _ inner -> functionAnnotation inner
  TypeVar _ -> true
  Any -> true
  _ -> false

typed :: ExprType -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
typed ty = NeutralExpr <<< Typed ty

reference :: Ref -> NeutralExpr
reference (Tuple name level) = typed Int (NeutralExpr (Local name level))

integer :: Int -> NeutralExpr
integer value = typed Int (NeutralExpr (Lit (LitInt value)))

binary :: ExprType -> Syn.BackendOperator2 -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
binary ty operator left right = typed ty (NeutralExpr (PrimOp (Syn.Op2 operator left right)))

compare :: Syn.BackendOperatorOrd -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr -> NeutralExpr
compare operator = binary Boolean (Syn.OpIntOrd operator)

CHANGELOG.md.text:
# Changelog

All notable changes to gopurs are recorded here. The format follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and the project uses
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## [Unreleased]

### Changed

- Emit native integer multiplication when operand bounds prove an exact
  product within the JavaScript Number integer range. Expose those bounds for
  counted translations while retaining ordinary IntMul semantics elsewhere.
- Reduce proven closed integer countdowns after thunk fusion, allowing existing
  affine loop optimization to eliminate repeated calls. Preserve strict reads,
  exact Int32 addition semantics and runtime input boundaries.
- Reduce fully consumed compositions of counted integer translations to guarded
  arithmetic. Preserve opaque runtime inputs, exact repeated-addition Int32
  semantics, and the original computation outside the proved input domain.
- Evaluate bounded closed recursive integer computations and record projections,
  retaining strict global reads and unknown computations. Bound interpreter
  work and stack depth separately, and allocate fresh residual bindings.
- Construct annotated Tuple results directly in the native representation
  required by their consumer, avoiding boxing and reconversion of composite
  fields while preserving the TAST and the existing public representation.
  Preserve constructor payloads and sum tags when converting native values
  to worker return values.
- Preserve boxed composite producers across annotations and local bindings
  until a consumer requires a native representation. Keep instantiated array
  and ADT-pointer payloads in native Tuple worker results; public wrappers
  retain the canonical boxed representation.
- Share literal record keys across allocations for records with one to five
  fields. Store two-Int records compactly while preserving immutable updates,
  field lookup and foreign conversion behavior.

## [0.1.1]

First final release, prepared from the RC20 compiler and pinned libraries.
Correct the recovery command's cyclic module import without rebuilding or
changing the qualified compiler.
Qualification and publication are recorded in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

- Compile the typed PureScript fork's TAST to Go with JavaScript or native
  compiler hosts, Release/Dev profiles and incremental compilation.
- Write ordinary Go FFI for values, records, callbacks, effects and cancellable
  asynchronous operations. The typed frontend is pinned to
  `ae6a6f644502bafcfa4fa94d8f81a1a1a1ca5080`; stock `purs` is not a substitute.
- Include RC20's callback, return-arity and ignored-Unit corrections, and the
  Foreign port's native readers preserving shared/cyclic child values.
- Refresh generated-code references against the preserved TAST types. Keep
  original compiler qualification and benchmark identities when reusing their
  exact bytes; record final packaging and fixture producers separately.

The supported reference is Node.js 24.8.0 and Go 1.27.0 on Linux amd64,
Linux arm64 and macOS arm64. This is a `0.x` release; the
[compatibility policy](docs/publication-scope.md) and
[limitations](docs/limitations.md) define its scope. The
[RC20 benchmark](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/release-benchmark.md#completed-rc20-campaign--13-november-2026-utc)
measures backend generation, not application runtime.

## [0.1.0] — not published

Signed tag `v0.1.0` remains available for traceability. Its CI stopped before
fixture execution or packaging because the artifact-acquisition command had
a cyclic module import. No npm package or GitHub release was published.
Version `0.1.1` resumes qualification with the corrected command and unchanged
RC20 compiler bytes.

## [0.1.0-rc.20]

Twentieth candidate for `0.1.0`, prepared on 13 November 2026. It corrects
compiler bridge defects exposed during local qualification.
Qualification and publication remain pending in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Convert curried callback values through the native FFI bridge instead of
  assuming that a foreign function is already a boxed runtime value.
- Consume the TAST arguments actually accepted by the Go implementation,
  including arguments of a returned function; preserve a function result when
  Go returns it. Add focused regressions for both bridge cases.
- Preserve the original TAST annotation at zero-argument Go wrappers' ignored
  `Unit` boundary, so `Unit -> Int` with Go `func() any` produces an `Int`
  rather than an extra function. Keep `Fn0` scalar and function results intact.
- Pin the Foreign port's safe readers for native Go strings, booleans, numbers
  and slices. Indexed reads recognize native slices; reading an array or a
  property preserves shared and cyclic native child values.

The frontend and other library pins remain those of RC19. The compiler changes
require a new benchmark and complete validation; the historical RC18 campaign
and its local RC19 equality proof do not qualify this candidate.

## [0.1.0-rc.19]

Nineteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, prepared on 13 November 2026, retaining
RC18's compiler, runtime and dependency pins. Qualification and publication
remain pending in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Include the Aff and Foreign native preflight paths in the isolated library
  cleanup fixture. Stub these preflights consistently with the other library
  runners, preserving the requirement to reach the mock Spago command and the
  neighbor-cache sentinels. Allow the isolated subprocess to start its own
  Node test runner by removing the inherited test-runner context from its
  environment. The real library scripts and native suites remain unchanged;
  this corrects the test setup that stopped RC18 qualification.

## [0.1.0-rc.18]

Eighteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining RC17's compiler and runtime.
Qualification and publication status remain in the live
[quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Refresh the Release and Dev `FFIIntegerReturns` snapshots for the ordinary
  FFI array conversion introduced in RC15. The references now use the runtime
  array accessors, matching the generated code already exercised successfully
  by the JavaScript and native hosts. Compiler and runtime behavior are unchanged.
- Select the Go Buffer port in the `node-net` and `node-streams` test
  configurations and generated locks. Their Release and Dev suites pass with
  this dependency selection; the bootstrap manifest pins the reviewed commits.
- Supply Spec's two missing node-child-process value helpers: an undefined
  sentinel distinct from null, and kill-signal dispatch matching the stock
  JavaScript number/string conversion. This supports Spec's test dependency,
  not the complete node-child-process API. Contract checks and the complete
  Release/Dev Spec suites cover the new source pin.
- Record the incomplete historical HTTP benchmark input separately from
  compiler qualification. Its reachable `stdout` foreign binding lacked a Go
  implementation; the current library port already supplies it. Historical
  inputs and measurements remain unchanged.

## [0.1.0-rc.17]

Seventeenth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining RC16's ordinary Go FFI contract,
dependency pins and frontend build fixes. Qualification and publication status
remain in the [quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md).

### Fixed

- Emit missing-FFI annotations with identical JSON key order and string escaping
  on the JavaScript and native compiler hosts. The metadata keeps the same
  schema and decoded values; generated executable code is unchanged. A real
  batch-compilation regression checks byte identity and JSON round-tripping
  across hosts, including Unicode, quotes, backslashes and literal escapes.

## [0.1.0-rc.16]

Sixteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining RC15's ordinary Go FFI, dependency
pins and compatibility scope. The [quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md)
tracks qualification and publication.

### Fixed

- Keep the selected typed and stock frontends rooted in Nix throughout CI and
  publication smoke tests, so garbage collection cannot remove them between
  build and execution.
- Correct the test domain in the Nix frontend dependency Foundation 0.0.30:
  integer division properties now exclude quotients that cannot be represented
  by their tested type, as well as division by zero. This prevents the
  reproducible `Int8 (-128) / (-1)` test overflow found during RC15 qualification.
  Foundation implementation code and test configuration are unchanged: Linux
  CI keeps the complete suite enabled; Darwin retains the pinned nixpkgs
  policy and was checked explicitly with the failing seed (6,121 tests).

## [0.1.0-rc.15]

Fifteenth experimental candidate for `0.1.0`. Its qualification and publication
status are recorded in the live [quality record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md)
and [release checklist](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/release-checklist.md).
At preparation on 12 November 2026, RC14 was the published candidate on `next`
and `latest` selected RC7. Local FFI results do not qualify RC15's final artifacts.

### Added

- [Ordinary Go FFI](docs/ffi-idiomatic.md): native `Effect` and `EffectFnAff`
  results, Go errors, optional `context.Context`, typed callbacks, opaque
  handles and closed-record conversion to local Go structs. Generated adapters
  own the runtime integration; handwritten implementations can use Go tooling
  directly. Direct ordinary `Aff`, open-record layout inference and a general
  multi-constructor ADT mapping remain outside this contract.
- Focused parser, runtime race, documented-example, end-to-end and installed
  package regressions, including both compiler hosts, cold/warm caches,
  signature changes, rejection and recovery.

### Fixed

- Keep asynchronous operations lazy and repeatable, arbitrate completion and
  cancellation, and release failed or late acquisitions exactly once before
  ownership transfers. Callbacks retained by a Go service follow that service's
  explicit unsubscribe/close lifetime.
- Convert dynamic `Foreign` data without JSON round-trips; preserve native
  handles, nested containers, null and a distinct undefined marker. Functions
  and algebraic constructors still require an explicit PureScript conversion.
- Diagnose missing TAST metadata before optimization and incompatible expanded
  `EffectFn2`/`EffectFn3` results with frontend, `PATH` and clean-output guidance.
  Require nominal `EffectFnAff` metadata for its ordinary Go ABI; retain valid
  explicit callback implementations. Preserve valid cache state after an FFI
  signature error.
- Validate missing FFI in explicitly selected entry-point scopes, and retain
  the cleanup of build/test tooling and the separately pinned Argonaut codecs
  support checkout already integrated since RC14.

### Changed

- Pin the typed frontend to `ae6a6f644502bafcfa4fa94d8f81a1a1a1ca5080`,
  `gopurs-aff` to `dbe9ff1c574a18352cf9ec861090083b14ca0246`, and
  `gopurs-foreign` to `c79499d6c22fd0637104bec5449434cfb6e31fe4`.
  Rebuild frontend output after switching revisions, preserving application
  `go.mod` and `go.sum`; the `purs` version number alone does not identify the
  required TAST contract. Existing explicit runtime FFI remains supported.

## [0.1.0-rc.14]

Fourteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, with a deterministic spec timeout fixture
following RC13's macOS Dev failure. The exact signed tag passed qualification
on all three supported platforms and its artifacts were reviewed. Published on
npm `next` and as a GitHub prerelease; public Hello, b8x compilation/linking and
the real `next` rollback to RC7 followed by restoration to RC14 passed. `latest`
remains RC7. The embedded documentation deviation and rollback scope are recorded in [the quality report](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md#rc14-qualification-and-artifact-review--5-november-2026).

### Fixed

- Pin `gopurs-spec` at `7bbb30f00bfde95cdb39286662bb5a0f71e3f368`
  ([spec PR #2](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs-spec/pull/2),
  reviewed and merged): replace the 15 ms body delay in the fail-fast timeout
  fixture with cancellable `never`, retaining the 10 ms timeout and golden
  output. Targeted local Dev and Release checks pass under CPU contention;
  they use a development toolchain and do not qualify this candidate.

Compiler/runtime, frontend, optimizer, all other source pins and CI workflows
are unchanged. RC13's tag and results remain unchanged.

## [0.1.0-rc.13]

Thirteenth candidate for `0.1.0`, correcting the CI input selector after RC12.
Compiler/runtime, frontend, optimizer, library pins and test corpus remain
unchanged. Qualification failed in macOS spec Dev: 73 passing, 3 pending and
one failing timeout fixture. Both Linux core jobs and macOS spec Release passed;
fixtures and finalization were skipped. RC13 remains unqualified and unpublished,
and its tag is immutable.

### Fixed

- Accept an aggregate GitHub run status of `queued` when selecting fixture,
  qualification or finalized inputs. Keep requiring the exact successful
  producer jobs, source and artifact identities, and signature checks.
  Pending or failed producers continue to block selection.

## [0.1.0-rc.12]

Twelfth candidate for `0.1.0`, correcting the Nix cache inventory check that
blocked RC11 before Linux quality tests. Compiler/runtime, frontend, optimizer,
library pins and test corpus remain unchanged. Three build/core jobs passed,
but nine fixture shards failed before import because the input selector
rejected the aggregate run status `queued`. The run subsequently completed
with failure. RC12 remains unqualified and unpublished; its signed tag is
immutable.

### Fixed

- Accept the empty `realisations` directory created by Nix 2.28.3 during a
  runtime-path cache export. Continue rejecting nonempty auxiliary directories,
  symlinks and unknown cache entries; no metadata is silently discarded.

## [0.1.0-rc.11]

Eleventh candidate for `0.1.0`, grouping CI recovery and documentation after
RC10's infrastructure failures. Compiler, runtime, TAST/frontend, optimizer
and library pins are unchanged. Both Linux jobs failed at the runtime-cache
export inventory check; RC11 remains unqualified and unpublished.

### Changed

- Reuse the build's exact locked Nix runtime environment in fixture shards,
  with bounded preparation and diagnostics, instead of rebuilding that
  environment in every shard.
- Retain the actual producer attempt for each qualification artifact so a
  targeted retry can reuse successful work from the same run and source.
  Exact compiler and toolchain identities remain required; historical tags
  and their qualification results are unchanged.

## [0.1.0-rc.10]

Tenth candidate for `0.1.0`, carrying the compiler/runtime and platform choices
of RC9 with the corrected spec source pin. Both qualification attempts failed
in environment/bootstrap preparation; the complete retry passed all three
builds and eleven fixture shards but timed out before the remaining shard's
tests. RC10 is unqualified and unpublished; RC7 remains public.

### Fixed

- Pin `gopurs-spec` at `c88da162df5d9ef85d672f5f2e819bb287e9647b`:
  await cancellation of compiler subprocesses and their process groups before
  reusing an integration directory; emit native child `close` only after
  stdout/stderr delivery and `exit`. Include native lifecycle and Aff
  cancellation regressions. Keep fixture source and golden output unchanged.
- Give a whole integration case, including cold compilation, a finite default
  budget of 300 seconds before parsing explicit timeout options. Log each
  preparation/runtime phase so future failures identify the expensive command.

Local corrected-source spec tests pass in Release and Dev (74 passing,
3 pending, all nine integration cases per profile). They use a development
frontend on macOS arm64 and do not replace this candidate's full qualification.

## [0.1.0-rc.9]

Ninth candidate for `0.1.0`, carrying the same compiler, runtime and dependency
pins as RC8. Qualification failed in the macOS spec integration tests; RC9
is unpublished and its tag remains immutable. RC7 remains public.

### Fixed

- Move both the macOS build and fixture jobs to the ARM64 `macos-15` runner.
  GitHub cancelled RC8's macOS job before any steps ran during the macOS 14
  retirement schedule. The new qualification does not establish compatibility
  with macOS 14. Keep the build and fixture runner matrices consistent through
  the CI policy regression test.

## [0.1.0-rc.8]

Eighth candidate for `0.1.0`, prepared from the post-RC7 fixes and reviewed
cleanup. Its macOS job was cancelled before any steps ran because GitHub
retired that runner image; the remaining campaign was cancelled. RC8 is
unqualified and unpublished. Its signed tag remains immutable, and RC7 remains
the published candidate.

The TAST frontend remains pinned to
`105f5752b39cc0f6c99a40064295338bf57ad223`, and the backend optimizer to
`4e7de48ffd6e19480ed3de6bfe8ca8227133be13`. The supported targets remain Linux
amd64/arm64 and macOS arm64. Rust stays experimental, and the documented
compatibility limits still apply. The existing benchmark record predates this
candidate; it does not establish RC8 performance results.

### Fixed

- Keep the original producer job and artifact attempt when GitHub copies a
  completed execution into retry metadata. Require matching execution evidence
  and keep newer failed or pending executions blocking recovery.
- Accept npm's absent-to-empty DSSE `keyid` serialization without changing
  signed payloads, signature bytes or cryptographic verification requirements.
- Pin the node-fs synchronous/asynchronous `chmod` and file stream fixes, the
  native node-streams pipe implementation, and the node-http/event-emitter
  response-body fixes. Preserve the targeted regressions and add the missing
  Go `stdout` adaptation used by the HTTP tests.
- Complete the identified uuid and js-bigints source metadata and attribution
  corrections without changing their library code or existing licenses.

### Changed

- Include all 51 pinned library suites through `bin/modtest` in future full
  release qualification, in Release and Dev profiles. Reuse the native compiler,
  trim the private Go cache between libraries, retain campaign reports and logs,
  and require exact library revisions and complete coverage before finalization.
  Ordinary quick CI and existing release tags keep their current scope.
- Replace external HTTP test endpoints with a local HTTPS fixture, retaining
  certificate verification and refusal tests. Remove the unused `go get`
  resolution of `strcase` from strings-extra.
- Derive the optional quick-CI frontend cache key from its Nix derivation and
  platform. Full candidate qualification continues to bypass this cache.
- Group compiler host services under `Gopurs.Host`, move the embedded runtime
  source under `Gopurs.Runtime.Source`, and document the module map and naming.
  Add output-identity and documentation checks; quick receipts now require all
  24 gates under `linux-quick-v2`. Check test inventories before CI builds.

The next candidate must validate its own exact artifacts, 371 gates per
platform (including 51 libraries and 401 fixtures in each profile), signatures
and installation. Historical RC7 and local post-RC7 results remain supporting
evidence only; they do not close those candidate gates. RC7 reinstallation has
been checked locally, but application suitability and public rollback remain
open in the release checklist.

## [0.1.0-rc.7]

Seventh candidate for `0.1.0`. RC6 was not published: its Linux amd64 core
campaign exposed an intermittent asynchronous emission failure. The macOS and
Linux arm64 core jobs passed; fixture shards did not run. Earlier tags remain
immutable.

### Fixed

- Return pipelined worker failures as explicit results and propagate them at
  dependency joins and producer boundaries. A worker error no longer escapes
  globally while its producer is suspended, including under supervision.
  Failures remain sticky and prevent queued dependent batches from starting.
- Include emission lifecycle regression tests in quick PR qualification.
- Retry signing and draft upload using the exact successful qualification of
  the same immutable tag, preserving the original test and compiler identities.
- Use pinned Node directly for finalization, avoiding a redundant Nix setup,
  and balance Release/Dev batches across the four existing fixture shards.

## [0.1.0-rc.6]

Sixth candidate for `0.1.0`, with the compiler and dependency pins of RC5.
RC5 passed all three core jobs and all twelve fixture shards, but final
attestation failed. It was not published; its signed tag remains immutable.

### Fixed

- Add a reproducible UUID serial number to the CycloneDX dependency inventory,
  required by the GitHub attestation action.
- Recover an existing Rekor entry when the signing service accepted a request
  but its retry returned HTTP 409. Continue to verify the complete signature,
  transparency-log proof, artifact digest and GitHub workflow identity before
  accepting the recovered entry.
- Publish using the CI provenance bundle already verified for the candidate,
  preserving the same attestation for publication recovery.

## [0.1.0-rc.5]

Fifth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the compiler, dependencies and feature
scope of RC4. RC4 was not published: all three core jobs and ten fixture shards
passed, but a Linux runner lost communication and two macOS fixtures could not
start Spago (`ENOENT`). The signed RC4 tag remains immutable.

### Changed

- Keep CI development tools reachable through a persistent Nix profile for the
  lifetime of each job. This adds an explicit garbage-collection root instead
  of relying on platform-dependent process inspection. Garbage collection has
  not been established as the cause of the RC4 macOS failure.
- Include the working directory and searched executable paths, with existence
  checks, when a fixture command cannot start. Preserve the original failure;
  do not silently retry or skip it.

## [0.1.0-rc.4]

Fourth candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the compiler, pinned dependencies,
features and limitations below. RC3 was not published: all three build/core
jobs passed, but fixture qualification failed. A local reproduction exposed a
race while initializing Spago's shared registry cache. The previous signed
candidate tags remain immutable.

### Fixed

- Initialize fixture dependencies once with `spago fetch` before starting
  parallel batches on a fresh runner. Keep fresh fixture workspaces, both build
  profiles, the existing resource limits and all 401 fixtures per profile.
- Preserve Spago diagnostics on a failed fixture by removing its quiet flag.
- Reuse qualified PR results after merge even when GitHub clears the run's PR
  association list, while checking the actual tested tree, parents, receipt,
  repository, run and artifact identity.
- Import cached frontend tools using their complete Nix store paths and verify
  the imported paths before recording success.

### Changed

- Run ordinary PR checks on Linux amd64 and skip heavy builds for documentation
  changes. Tags and explicit full campaigns retain all three supported targets.
- Cache the pinned frontend runtime closure for quick runs; missing or unusable
  cache entries fall back to a fresh build. Full release runs remain independent
  of this cache.
- Align active public installation examples and candidate tables with this
  version, and check tag/package/lockfile/changelog agreement before heavy builds.

## [0.1.0-rc.3]

Third candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the compiler, pinned dependencies,
features and limitations of the candidates below. RC2 was not published:
its Linux core gates passed, but the checkout action replaced the local
annotated tag with its peeled commit and artifact preparation rejected it.
The signed RC1 and RC2 tags are retained.

### Fixed

- Select release tags explicitly in every CI checkout, preserving their
  annotated objects while retaining the default commit selection for PRs.
- Check source commit and annotated tag identity immediately after checkout.
  Verify that the local tag object matches GitHub's verified signature before
  starting the release build.

## [0.1.0-rc.2]

Second candidate for `0.1.0`, retaining the frontend, bootstrap dependencies,
features and known limitations listed for `0.1.0-rc.1` below. The first candidate
was not published to npm or GitHub Releases: its full macOS gate timed out while
compiling the native scanner test, and both Linux jobs reached their six-hour
limit during the fixture campaign. The signed first-candidate tag is retained.

### Fixed

- Compile the native scanner, preparation and emission functional probes without
  Go optimizations for their large compiler package, keeping the existing memory
  budget, assertions, execution deadlines, scanner stack limit and race checks.
  Release compiler binaries retain their optimized bootstrap profile.
- Include the scanner and preparation probes in the quick CI campaign so their
  compilation and execution are checked before creating another release tag.
- Publish build manifests, FFI digests and global-function sidecars from each
  cache session's private stage. Concurrent builds no longer share a temporary
  sidecar path that another writer can rename, causing an `ENOENT` failure.
- Separate full CI into core checks and four fixture shards per platform,
  reusing the exact candidate compiler. Require complete Release/Dev coverage
  and matching source, compiler and run identities before signing artifacts.
- Upload stable quality logs and reports instead of live generated workspaces,
  avoiding missing-file errors while interrupted processes clean up temporary
  compiler snapshots.

## [0.1.0-rc.1]

First release candidate for `0.1.0`, using the typed PureScript compiler at
`105f5752b39cc0f6c99a40064295338bf57ad223` and the bootstrap libraries pinned in
`bootstrap-sources.json`. The [qualification record](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/quality-0.1.0.md)
distinguishes completed local checks from the remaining tag and public-install
gates. The [benchmark protocol](https://github.com/0x000000000000000000001/gopurs/blob/main/docs/release-benchmark.md) defines the cold and
warm measurements; the historical reference is the official altbak.pub table.

### Added

- First public release candidate preparation for `0.1.0`.
- PureScript-to-Go backend driven by typed TAST.
- JavaScript, native Go and experimental Rust compiler hosts.
- Content-verified incremental cache and optional Go package layout.
- Go runtime, FFI bridge and event loop.
- Compiler bootstrap documentation, checksums and clean-install checks.
- Publication scope, limitations, migration, CLI, quickstart and troubleshooting
  documentation.
- npm package allowlist and package-surface check.
- CI for Linux arm64/amd64 and macOS arm64.
- Nix packages, apps, development shell and application checks with pinned
  frontend, Node.js and Go toolchains.
- Public, commit-pinned bootstrap library inventory and `bin/setup --locked`.
- Versioned Argonaut codec adaptation for the native bootstrap.

### Fixed

- Go `int32` FFI arguments and results preserve signed integer values through
  scalar, array and callback bridges instead of falling through to pointer
  unboxing.

- The private output-barrier cache test now copies the `c1c` module resolved by
  `build-cache/go.mod`.
- Cache transition tests pin the monolithic layout and disable pack publication
  when they inspect individual cache objects.
- The context-transition check accounts for prepared fingerprints that are
  legitimately reused within a run.

### Known limitations

- The backend remains experimental and is not a drop-in replacement for the
  upstream PureScript compiler.
- The typed compiler fork and Go library ports are separate prerequisites.
- Stock PureScript libraries expose JavaScript FFI and may fail at runtime when
  a foreign declaration is reached.
- Windows, 32-bit targets, daemon/resident modes and the Rust host are outside
  the `0.1.x` production contract.
- Performance figures are measurements, not guarantees.

### Security

- No public security release has been made yet. See `SECURITY.md`.

  ( translate
  , translateWithFunctions
  , PreparedModule
  , prepareModule
  , workerInputs
  , workerOwners
  , globalTypeDemands
  , translatePreparedWithFunctions
  ) where

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendOperator2(..), BackendSyntax(PrimEffect, PrimOp, Branch, Fail, CtorDef, CtorSaturated, Lit, UncurriedAbs, Abs, Update, Accessor, LetRec, Let, EffectDefer, EffectPure, EffectBind, UncurriedEffectAbs, UncurriedEffectApp, UncurriedApp, App, Local, Var, Typed))

translate :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> String
translate metadata inputMod = (translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod).code

translateWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translateWithFunctions metadata inputMod = translatePreparedWithFunctions metadata (prepareModule metadata inputMod)

type PreparedModule =
  { module :: BackendModule
  , declarations :: Array GoDecl
  , functions :: ModuleFunctions
  , workers :: Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
  }

-- These transformations consume source metadata, not imported worker signatures
-- or module-local FFI signatures. Prepare once, before computing the emission
-- key, so references introduced by a transformation belong to its proof too.
prepareModule :: CodegenMetadata -> BackendModule -> PreparedModule
prepareModule metadata inputMod =
  let
    projected = ListFusion.optimize (RegexMatchProjection.optimize metadata inputMod)
    progressions = ListProgressionFold.prepare projected
    constants = ClosedScalar.optimize progressions.module
    constructors = ConstructorFold.optimize constants
    schemas = specializeDecoderSchemas metadata (borrowReadOnlyObjects metadata (cacheClosedDictionaries metadata (optimizeImmediateApplications (optimizeFunctionProducers (optimizeThunkProducers constructors)))))
    owned = Ownership.prepare metadata schemas.module
  in
    { module: owned.module
    , declarations: owned.declarations <> schemas.declarations <> progressions.declarations
    , functions: Map.union owned.functions progressions.functions
    , workers: workerInputs metadata.globalFunctions owned.module
    }

-- Imported ordinary and immediate-effect workers use qualified Var targets;
-- local targets use the module's
-- own signatures. Include every such Var, even if it is not called, and record
-- absences in the exact batch snapshot. TCO preserves these qualifications.
workerInputs :: ModuleFunctions -> BackendModule -> Map.Map String (Maybe FunctionInfo)
workerInputs available = foldWorkerReferences
  (\owner name acc -> foldl
    (\entries ident -> let key = unwrap owner <> "." <> ident in Map.insert key (Map.lookup key available) entries)
    acc [ name, ImmediateEffects.key name ])
  Map.empty

-- The emitter can resolve immutable owner contributions without decoding every
-- earlier module's signatures. Keep the exact qualified-Var inventory shared
-- with workerInputs, including FFI targets and references introduced by passes.
workerOwners :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
workerOwners = foldWorkerReferences (\owner _ -> Set.insert (unwrap owner)) Set.empty

-- Conservative requests are collected explicitly by the emitter. They do not
-- need to be complete: LookupTable checks coverage on every actual lookup.
globalTypeDemands :: BackendModule -> Set.Set String
globalTypeDemands mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  (Set.fromFoldable
    [ "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.schemaDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Parser.textDecoderABI1"
    , "Data.Argonaut.Decode.Internal.Record.borrowObject"
    , RegexMatchProjection.helperName
    , RegexMatchProjection.adapterName
    ]) mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) -> Set.insert (unwrap owner <> "." <> name) acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

foldWorkerReferences :: forall a. (CoreFn.ModuleName -> String -> a -> a) -> a -> BackendModule -> a
foldWorkerReferences insert initial mod = foldl
  (\acc group -> foldl (\entries (Tuple _ value) -> visit entries value) acc group.bindings)
  initial
  mod.bindings
  where
  visit acc (NeutralExpr syntax) = case syntax of
    Var (Qualified (Just owner) (Ident name)) | owner /= mod.name ->
      insert owner name acc
    _ -> foldl visit acc syntax

-- Source metadata must be the same as at preparation. Output supplies the
-- freshly parsed local FFI signatures here. Restrict imported signatures to
-- exactly the snapshot covered by the emission key, including on fresh builds.
translatePreparedWithFunctions :: CodegenMetadata -> PreparedModule -> { code :: String, functions :: ModuleFunctions, file :: GoFile }
translatePreparedWithFunctions sourceMetadata prepared =
  let
    metadata = sourceMetadata { globalFunctions = Map.mapMaybe identity prepared.workers }
    mod = prepared.module
    modNameStrOrig = unwrap mod.name
    modNameStr = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modNameStrOrig

    codegenStateRef :: Ref CodegenState
    codegenStateRef = unsafePerformEffect $
      Ref.new { declarations: ModuleDeclarations.constructors metadata modNameStr mod, globalId: 0, reboxPairs: Set.empty }

    preparedBindings = ModuleBindings.prepare metadata modNameStr mod
    -- The module's FFI functions are keyed by raw identifier; local functions
    -- take precedence when names collide.
    -- Reserved immediate-effect signatures must never become ordinary local
    -- calls after sanitizing their otherwise impossible PureScript names.
    ffiLocalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.mapMaybe
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> map (Tuple (sanitizeName name)) (Map.lookup name metadata.ffiFunctions))
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    moduleFunctions = Map.union (Map.union prepared.functions preparedBindings.functions) ffiLocalFunctions
    normalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ Array.concatMap
      (\group -> Array.mapMaybe
        (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> do
          info <- Map.lookup (sanitizeName name) moduleFunctions
          guard (info.arity >= 1 && info.arity <= 10)
          pure (Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info))
        group.bindings)
      preparedBindings.bindings
    -- Export FFI functions as `<Module>.<ident>` for callers in other modules.
    ffiGlobalFunctions = Map.fromFoldable $ map
      (\(Tuple name info) -> Tuple (unwrap mod.name <> "." <> name) info)
      (Map.toUnfoldable metadata.ffiFunctions :: Array (Tuple String FunctionInfo))

    Tuple allDeclsAst helpers = unsafePerformEffect do
      let
        d = ModuleBindings.declarations translateExpr metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr moduleFunctions preparedBindings.bindings
      h <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
      pure (Tuple d h)

    foreignGetters = map
      (\(Tuple (Ident name) _) -> GoForeignGetter
        { name: generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> sanitizeName name)
        , value: foreignSymbol modNameStr ("_Gopurs_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> capitalize (sanitizeName name))
        })
      (Map.toUnfoldable mod.foreign)
    declarationGroups =
      [ allDeclsAst <> prepared.declarations
      , helpers.declarations <> unsafePerformEffect (generateReboxFunctions metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr)
      , foreignGetters
      ]
    goFile = { packageName: "purescript", imports: collectImports declarationGroups, declarationGroups }

  in
    { code: printGoFile goFile
    , functions: Map.union normalFunctions ffiGlobalFunctions
    , file: goFile
    }

translateExpr :: TranslateExpr
translateExpr context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound, options: { inEffectBlock }, mbExpectedExprType } nextId tcoExpr@(TcoExpr _ expr) =
  let
    child = childContext context Nothing
    isEff = isEffectNode tcoExpr
  in
    if isEff && not inEffectBlock then
      EffectExprs.wrap translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr
    else
      case expr of
        Typed type_ a ->
          TypedExprs.annotated translateExpr context nextId type_ a
        Var (Qualified mbMn (Ident i)) ->
          let
            safeName = sanitizeName i
            vType = case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                in
                  case LookupTable.lookup (modStr <> "." <> i) metadata.globalTypes of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
              Nothing -> TypeValue
          in
            case mbMn of
              Just mn ->
                let
                  modStr = unwrap mn
                  modPkg = String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") modStr
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modPkg ("Get_" <> modPkg <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }
              Nothing ->
                let
                  rawCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Get_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> safeName)))) []
                in
                  { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr rawCall TypeValue vType, exprType: vType, nextId }

        Local mbIdent lvl ->
          let
            v = fromMaybe { name: localId mbIdent lvl, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup (localId mbIdent lvl) bound)
          in
            { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar v.name, exprType: v.goType, nextId }

        Lit value
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.literal value ->
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId }

        Lit (LitArray xs) ->
          LiteralExprs.array translateExpr context nextId xs

        Lit (LitRecord props) ->
          LiteralExprs.record translateExpr context nextId (getExprType tcoExpr) props

        expr_
          | ( case expr_ of
                App _ _ -> true
                Syn.TypeApp _ _ -> true
                _ -> false
            ) ->
              CallExprs.application translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr

        Abs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.abstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.uncurriedApplication translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr fn args

        UncurriedAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.uncurriedAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        UncurriedEffectApp fn args ->
          CallExprs.effectApplication translateExpr context nextId fn args

        UncurriedEffectAbs args body ->
          FunctionExprs.effectAbstraction translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr args body

        EffectBind mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          EffectExprs.bindEffect translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        EffectPure binding ->
          EffectExprs.pureValue translateExpr context nextId binding

        EffectDefer binding ->
          EffectExprs.defer translateExpr context nextId binding

        Let mbIdent lvl binding body ->
          BindingExprs.nonRecursive translateExpr context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

        LetRec lvl bindings body ->
          BindingExprs.recursive translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr lvl bindings body

        Accessor obj accessor ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
          in
            case accessor of
              GetProp prop ->
                let
                  result = RecordExprs.getProp metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr prop { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetIndex idx -> { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayAccess") [ (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resObj.expr resObj.exprType), GoInt idx ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              GetCtorField (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident ctorName) _ idx ->
                let
                  result = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
                    { moduleName: mbMod, ctorName, index: idx }
                    { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType, sourceType: getExprType obj }
                in
                  { stmts: resObj.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resObj.nextId }

        Update obj props ->
          let
            resObj = translateExpr child nextId obj
            accProps = foldl
              ( \acc (Prop key val) ->
                  let
                    resVal = translateExpr child acc.nextId val
                  in
                    { stmts: acc.stmts <> resVal.stmts, exprs: Array.snoc acc.exprs { key, expr: resVal.expr, goType: resVal.exprType }, exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resVal.nextId }
              )
              { stmts: StmtEmpty, exprs: [], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resObj.nextId }
              props
            resultType = map (exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr) mbExpectedExprType
            result = RecordExprs.update codegenStateRef modNameStr resultType { expr: resObj.expr, exprType: resObj.exprType } accProps.exprs
          in
            { stmts: resObj.stmts <> accProps.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: accProps.nextId }

        CtorDef _ _ (Ident name) fields ->
          ConstructorExprs.definition context nextId tcoExpr name fields

        CtorSaturated (Qualified mbMod _) _ _ (Ident name) props ->
          ConstructorExprs.saturated translateExpr context nextId tcoExpr mbMod name props

        Fail msg ->
          ControlExprs.failure context nextId tcoExpr msg

        Branch branches def ->
          ControlExprs.branch translateExpr context nextId branches def

        PrimOp (Op1 op1 e)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.unary codegenStateRef modNameStr op1 ->
              let
                resE = translateExpr child nextId e
                result = emit { expr: resE.expr, exprType: resE.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified mbMod (Ident tag))) e) ->
          let
            -- A pointer ADT's tag is independent of its type arguments. Keep
            -- the operand's representation: coercing a boxed List here would
            -- copy its entire tail merely to distinguish Nil from Cons.
            translateOperand expected operand@(TcoExpr _ syntax) =
              case syntax of
                Typed type_ inner
                  | TypeStructPointer _ <- exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr type_ ->
                      translateOperand (Just type_) inner
                _ ->
                  translateExpr (child { mbExpectedExprType = expected }) nextId operand
            resE = translateOperand Nothing e
          in
            AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr mbMod tag resE

        PrimOp (Op1 OpArrayLength e) ->
          let
            resE = translateExpr child nextId e
          in
            case resE.exprType of
              TypeNativeArray _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "len") [ resE.expr ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }
              _ -> { stmts: resE.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "ArrayLength") [ boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resE.expr resE.exprType ] ] ], exprType: TypeValue, nextId: resE.nextId }

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanAnd e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanAnd translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpBooleanOr e1 e2) ->
          ControlExprs.booleanOr translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 OpArrayIndex e1 e2) ->
          ArrayIntrinsics.unsafeIndex translateExpr context nextId e1 e2

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.stringLengthComparison translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just result <- PrimitiveExprs.boundedIntProduct translateExpr context nextId op2 e1 e2 ->
              result

        PrimOp (Op2 op2 e1 e2)
          | Just emit <- PrimitiveExprs.binary codegenStateRef modNameStr op2 ->
              let
                res1 = translateExpr child nextId e1
                res2 = translateExpr child res1.nextId e2
                result = emit { expr: res1.expr, exprType: res1.exprType } { expr: res2.expr, exprType: res2.exprType }
              in
                { stmts: res1.stmts <> res2.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: res2.nextId }

        PrimEffect eff ->
          EffectExprs.primitive translateExpr context nextId eff

        _ -> { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Value{}", exprType: TypeValue, nextId }
